title: NBA Sim Possession Plays (foundation 0.1.0)
description: Frozen play catalog for v0.1.0. Closed set of 5 hardcoded play objects (decision Metis G3.5: NOT a play DSL or play editor). Each play carries a mode (TRANSITION or HALFCOURT per decision M4 — EARLY_OFFENSE is excluded), the 5 offensive RoleSlots it expects to be filled by bindRoles (T16), and an ordered steps list. Action/on_success/on_fail labels are play-internal state names; cross-reference of those that match EventType names against config/event-catalog.json is enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs (todo 9 linter). Duration identifiers are cross-referenced against config/duration.json by the same linter.

foundation_version.description: Semver stamp of the plays contract. Must match config/foundation.json#foundation_version.

modes.$comment: v0.1.0 freeze: exactly the two values TRANSITION and HALFCOURT. minItems=maxItems=2 plus the items enum covering only those two values together force the array to be a 2-element permutation of {TRANSITION, HALFCOURT}. Both allOf branches below additionally pin canonical order (TRANSITION first, HALFCOURT second) so the verification gate `jq '.modes'` returns the canonical array.

plays.$comment: Closed 7-entry catalog for v0.2.0. Uniqueness of `id` is enforced by scripts/check-foundation.mjs; JSON Schema draft-07 has no portable way to pin a closed id set.

allOf.$comment: Enforce both modes are present (TRANSITION and HALFCOURT) using contains branches so order cannot drift silently. ajv strict mode requires `const` value to have a matching type declaration; `const` on a string is fine because the schema declares the array items as strings above.

id.description: Play identifier. Lowercase snake_case. v0.1.0 set: transition_push, handoff_wing, pnr_high, iso_clear, early_drag.

mode.description: Possession mode this play belongs to. EARLY_OFFENSE is intentionally absent (decision M4).

slots.description: The 5 offensive RoleSlots this play binds (cross-referenced with docs/foundation/identity-roles.md T7). All 5 slots must be present; the bind algorithm (T16) must populate each.

steps.$comment: Ordered list of play steps. The engine walks steps starting from index 0; on_success and on_fail name the next action label (which may match a step.action or be a sentinel like TURNOVER/PASS_TO_SPACER/END). Reachability of every label is enforced by the foundation linter in todo 9.

allOf.$comment: Enforce all 5 RoleSlots are present (order-independent). Each `contains` branch pins one slot name. Combined with minItems=maxItems=5 above, this forces the slots array to be a permutation of the 5 canonical RoleSlot names.

action.description: Action label for this step. Some labels coincide with EventType names from config/event-catalog.json (ADVANCE_BACKCOURT, CROSS_HALF, ALIGN_HALFCOURT, HANDOFF, SCREEN_SET, SCREEN_USE, SHOT_RELEASE, PASS, TURNOVER). Others (ATTACK_RIM, DRIVE_OR_SHOOT, ISO_DRIVE, PASS_TO_SPACER) are play-internal control states that the engine resolves into emitted events (typically a DRIVE event). Cross-reference enforced by the foundation linter (todo 9).

actor_slot.description: The RoleSlot whose bound player performs this action. Validation that actor_slot is also a member of this play's `slots` array is performed by the foundation linter (todo 9); JSON Schema cannot express array-membership-from-sibling-field portably in draft-07.

duration_id.description: Duration identifier consumed by the duration sampler (T13). Cross-referenced against config/duration.json by the foundation linter (todo 9).

on_success.description: Next action label when the resolve check passes. The sentinel END terminates the play. Sentinels TURNOVER and PASS route to the corresponding event resolution path.

on_fail.description: Next action label when the resolve check fails. Same labeling rules as on_success.
